subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Gonadotoxicity, fertility preservation and sexual function

steps.tx: Gonadal toxicity from several drugs given together is **additive**, so each agent adds its own share of damage. The **cumulative dose** of each drug matters more than the dose rate. Combination regimens show no evidence of **synergy**, so the risk can be estimated by adding individual doses. **Cyclophosphamide** alone needs 19 grams per square metre for lasting sterility in half of men, but only 15 grams per square metre with a median **doxorubicin** dose of 450 milligrams per square metre.
steps.say: Gonadal toxicity from several drugs given together is additive, so each agent adds its own share of damage. The cumulative dose of each drug matters more than how quickly it is given. Combination regimens show no evidence of synergy, so the risk can be estimated by adding the individual doses. Cyclophosphamide alone needs about nineteen grams per square metre to cause lasting sterility in half of men. With a median doxorubicin dose of four hundred and fifty milligrams per square metre, that falls to fifteen grams per square metre.

cols: Cyclophosphamide dose for lasting sterility in half of men
rows: With median doxorubicin 450 milligrams per square metre

steps.tx: **Alkylating agents** are the most sterilizing class, and high-dose **cisplatin** is also strongly toxic. **Chlorambucil** and **cyclophosphamide** given alone cause prolonged **azoospermia**, while **procarbazine** is also highly sterilizing and **busulfan** is likely to cause it when combined with other drugs. By contrast, **methotrexate** and **vincristine** produce only temporary drops in sperm count at usual doses.
steps.say: Alkylating agents are the most sterilizing class, and high-dose cisplatin is also strongly toxic. Chlorambucil and cyclophosphamide given alone cause prolonged azoospermia. Procarbazine is also highly sterilizing, while busulfan is likely to cause azoospermia, usually alongside other drugs. By contrast, methotrexate and vincristine produce only temporary drops in sperm count at usual doses. Dacarbazine is the single alkylating agent that belongs in that milder group.

right.title: Temporary drop in sperm count
points: Dacarbazine, the only alkylating agent here

steps.tx: **Spermatogonia**, the dividing stem cells of sperm production, are destroyed by many cytotoxic drugs, which can leave the semen without sperm (**azoospermia**). **Leydig cells**, which make testosterone, are largely spared by most chemotherapy regimens, so puberty timing and testosterone levels usually stay normal. The exception is busulfan plus cyclophosphamide before stem cell transplant, which delays puberty in about 30% of boys. Radiation follows a similar pattern, needing more than 18 grays (Gy) before Leydig damage.
steps.say: Spermatogonia are the dividing stem cells of sperm production, and many cytotoxic drugs destroy them. Losing them can leave the semen without sperm, a state called azoospermia. Most chemotherapy regimens largely spare the Leydig cells that make testosterone, so puberty timing and testosterone levels usually stay normal. One exception is busulfan plus cyclophosphamide before stem cell transplant, which delays puberty in about thirty percent of boys. Radiation follows a similar pattern, with Leydig damage needing more than eighteen grays.

steps.tx: **Embryo cryopreservation** is the most successful fertility preservation method for women, and it is preferred whenever it is viable, such as when a partner or donor sperm is available. **Oocyte vitrification** (rapid freezing of eggs) suits a woman without a partner. A standard **in vitro fertilisation** (IVF) cycle takes 2 to 3 weeks, which can delay cancer treatment.
steps.say: Embryo cryopreservation is the most successful fertility preservation method for women, and it is preferred whenever it is viable. Oocyte vitrification, which means rapid freezing of eggs, suits a woman without a partner. A standard in vitro fertilisation cycle takes two to three weeks, which can delay cancer treatment. Current ASCO guidance from 2025 lists embryo, oocyte and ovarian tissue cryopreservation as established methods.

steps.tx: **Ovarian tissue cryopreservation** removes ovarian cortex containing many **primordial follicles**, freezes thin slices, and grafts them back later. Because **ovarian stimulation** is unnecessary, the method suits girls who have not reached puberty. Its main drawback is the chance of returning malignant cells to the patient, a concern that matters most in **leukemia**.
steps.say: Ovarian tissue cryopreservation removes strips of ovary containing many primordial follicles, freezes thin slices, and grafts them back later. No ovarian stimulation is needed, so the method suits girls who have not reached puberty. Its main drawback is the possibility of returning malignant cells to the patient, a worry that matters most in leukemia. Experimental laboratory maturation of follicles could one day remove that risk.

right.title: Oocyte or embryo cryopreservation
points: One IVF cycle takes 2 to 3 weeks
Embryo banking is the most successful option

steps.tx: **Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH)** analogs have uncertain value for protecting the ovary during chemotherapy. Human studies have not shown consistent benefit across cancer treatments. Their clearer role is **menstrual suppression**, which can limit heavy bleeding during blood cancers. ASCO guidance says they should not be used in place of established methods, and they may be offered as an **adjunct**.
steps.say: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogs have uncertain value for protecting the ovary during chemotherapy. Human studies have not shown consistent benefit across cancer treatments. Most studies also fail to support hormone treatment for girls before their first period. Their clearer role is suppressing menstruation, which can limit heavy bleeding during blood cancers. ASCO guidance says these drugs should not replace established methods, and they may be offered as an adjunct.

left.title: Supported role
points: Adjunct for breast cancer patients, per ASCO 2025

right.title: Not a substitute
points: Cannot replace oocyte or embryo banking
Girls before their first period: no clear benefit

steps.tx: The **International Index of Erectile Function** (IIEF) is a validated, self-completed scale that measures sexual function after prostate cancer. It takes 5 to 10 minutes, which makes it practical in clinic. The abridged **Sexual Health Inventory for Men** (SHIM) is a validated shorter version, used to grade **erectile dysfunction** and track treatment response.
steps.say: The International Index of Erectile Function is a validated, self-completed scale that measures sexual function after prostate cancer. It takes five to ten minutes, which makes it practical in a clinic. The abridged Sexual Health Inventory for Men is a validated shorter version. Clinicians use it to grade erectile dysfunction and to track how well treatment works.
